name: vnpay-local-sandbox-guard
title: Chặn cổng thanh toán production khi chạy local
description: Đảm bảo môi trường development/local luôn tạo giao dịch MoMo/VNPAY sandbox dù cấu hình nhà hàng còn lưu production, trừ khi có opt-in rõ ràng.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The previous platform fallback fix does not cover an active restaurant-scoped credential stored as production. Local development must fail safe to sandbox at the shared credential mode boundary. Vite ECONNABORTED is a transient Socket.IO disconnect and is unrelated to payUrl generation.
